Dragon Ball Z originally aired in Japan on Fuji TV from April 26, 1989 to January 31, 1996, running for 291 episodes [d3][d4]. In the United States, the series initially aired in first-run syndication starting September 13, 1996, with the premiere episode "The Arrival of Raditz" [d6][d7]. After being cancelled in syndication by mid-1998, it found renewed success when it began airing on Cartoon Network's Toonami programming block on August 31, 1998, where it became immensely popular [d6]. The series was also dubbed and broadcast in at least 81 countries worldwide, with the British Comedy Network airing it in Fall 1998 [d1].
